title: HistorIQly: AI History Chat
description:
History is easier to remember when you can question it.

HistorIQly turns world history into interactive, AI-generated conversations. Explore interpretations of historical figures, take guided lessons, compare ideas in debates, and build a learning path that rewards curiosity.

Ask Cleopatra about power. Question Einstein about time. Put Plato and Aristotle into a three-round debate and decide who makes the stronger case.

These conversations are AI-generated interpretations—not the real people or verbatim historical records. Responses may be inaccurate. Verify important claims with reliable sources.

CHAT WITH HISTORICAL FIGURES
Choose from philosophers, scientists, rulers, writers, artists, reformers, and thinkers across regions and eras. Ask your own questions and switch between Beginner, Explain, Sources, and Advanced response levels where your plan allows.

TAKE GUIDED HISTORY LESSONS
Lesson mode breaks a topic into short sections with checkpoint questions. Follow a path, test your understanding, and return to unfinished lessons. You can also take a short quiz based on a conversation.

STAGE DEBATES AND ROUNDTABLES
Pair two figures for a three-round debate and select the winner of each round. Roundtable mode lets up to four figures respond to the same question, making it easier to compare competing perspectives.

STEP INTO HISTORICAL SCENARIOS
Enter curated, date-pinned moments designed around what a figure could have known at the time. Scenario availability varies by figure.

LISTEN TO HISTORY
Hear replies read aloud, ask questions with voice input, or create a generated two-figure Podcast episode. Availability varies by plan; voice playback and Podcast generation use daily credits.

EXPLORE PROFILES AND SELECTED SOURCES
Profiles include biographies, influences, contemporaries, and source references where available. Read longer Chronicles and browse Library entries such as books and letters. Sources response level asks the AI to emphasize quotations and attribution, but AI output can still contain mistakes.

SAVE INSIGHTS AND KEEP LEARNING
Save signed-in conversation history and continue where you left off. Collect useful passages in an Insight Journal, organize them by theme, and return to them later.

Earn XP through conversations, lesson checkpoints, debates, quizzes, and saved insights. Complete daily quests, maintain a streak, unlock badges, track mastery, and advance through five Scholar's Path ranks.

ASK ABOUT YOUR OWN MATERIAL
On eligible plans, attach PDF, Word, and text documents to a chat and ask questions about their content. Live-data commands can also look up selected current information.

CHOOSE THE PLAN THAT FITS
• Free: core chat access, Beginner responses, and post-chat quizzes.
• Premium: all four response levels, guided lessons, standard voice, Roundtables, Scenarios, figure memory, and document attachments.
• Pro: the full featured figure catalog, Debates, Podcast mode, expressive figure voices, voice input, and web search.

Feature access and daily credit limits vary by plan. Paid subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in Google Play. Prices and subscription details are shown by Google Play.

Built for history enthusiasts, students, teachers, independent learners, writers, trivia fans, and anyone who learns by asking questions.

title: HistoryTalk: AI History Chat
description:
HistoryTalk: AI History Chat

Ever wondered what it would be like to talk to Albert Einstein, Aristotle, Cleopatra, or other fascinating figures from history? With HistoryTalk, you can explore the past in a whole new way through AI-powered conversations with historical figures and characters.

HistoryTalk is an AI history chat app designed for curious minds who want to discover history, explore ideas, and learn through interactive conversations. Ask questions, exchange ideas, and explore the thoughts and perspectives of people who shaped history.

💬 Chat with Historical Figures

Go beyond reading about the past. Start an AI-powered conversation with historical personalities and explore their ideas, discoveries, and legacies.

Talk with famous historical figures.
Ask questions about their lives, achievements, and ideas.
Explore different perspectives on historical events.
Discover fascinating stories from different periods of history.

Whether you're interested in scientists, philosophers, leaders, or other influential personalities, HistoryTalk offers a new way to engage with the past.

🧠 Explore History with AI

HistoryTalk combines artificial intelligence with historical exploration to make learning more interactive and engaging.

Use AI character chat to ask questions, explore interesting topics, and discover connections between people, ideas, and events. Turn your curiosity into conversations and explore subjects you might not encounter in a traditional history book.

From ancient civilizations to groundbreaking scientific discoveries, there is always something new to explore.

🔬 Discover Science, Philosophy and Ideas

History is full of thinkers whose ideas continue to influence the world today. Use HistoryTalk to explore topics such as:

Science and groundbreaking discoveries
Philosophy and timeless questions
Historical events and civilizations
Famous people and their achievements
Culture, mythology, and influential ideas

Ask questions, follow your curiosity, and explore different subjects through conversational AI.

🌍 A New Way to Experience the Past

Traditional history learning often means reading facts and dates. HistoryTalk offers a more interactive experience by letting you engage with historical personalities through AI-generated conversations.

Whether you're a history enthusiast, a student, or simply curious about the people who changed the world, you can use HistoryTalk to discover new perspectives and make learning more engaging.

✨ Why Try HistoryTalk?
AI-powered historical character conversations
An interactive way to explore history
Conversations inspired by famous personalities
Opportunities to discover science, philosophy, and culture
A fun experience for curious minds and lifelong learners
📚 Learn, Explore and Ask Questions

Who were the people behind the world's greatest ideas? What inspired their discoveries? How did historical events shape the world we live in today?

Open HistoryTalk, choose a historical personality, and start exploring.

Download HistoryTalk: AI History Chat and discover a new way to connect with the past.

Note: Conversations are generated by AI and are intended for educational and entertainment purposes. AI-generated responses may not always be historically accurate and should not be treated as direct quotations or verified statements from historical figures.

title: Hello History - AI Chat
description:
Hello History, you can travel back in time and have one-on-one chat conversations with some of the most influential historical figures of all time

Who Hello History is for?

- History Teachers eager to enrich their classrooms
- School Principals seeking innovative learning tools
- History Buffs craving deeper connections with the past
- AI Enthusiasts fascinated by state-of-the-art tech
- Anyone who've always wanted to "meet" historical figures

💡 Key Features:

- Authentic Conversations with AI Historical Figures
- Curated Topics for Tailored Learning
- Easy-to-Use Interface
- Regular Updates with New Figures
- Multi-disciplinary Focus: Art, Science, Philosophy, and more

🕰 Why Hello History?

Unearth the wisdom of ages with Hello History! Engage in riveting 
one-on-one chats with AI versions of history's most iconic figures. 
State-of-the-art GPT-4 AI technology makes each interaction uniquely 
authentic.

🌎 Broaden Your Horizons
From art and music to justice and military strategy, pick the brain of your favorite genius in a myriad of disciplines. It's not just a history lesson; it's a fresh perspective on life itself!

🎓 Elevate Your Teaching
For educators, it’s like having a co-teacher from the annals of history! Enhance your students' engagement and understanding by integrating these AI-generated conversations into your curriculum.

🔬 Highly Advanced, Yet User-Friendly
Even if you're not tech-savvy, the intuitive UI makes it easy to navigate conversations. And for AI fans, witness the marvel of GPT-4 technology in action.

Immerse yourself in the minds of the greats and gain new insights and perspectives on life, history, and the world around us with the help of AI chat.

Whether you're interested in learning more about art, music, justice, literature, philosophy, science, technology, or even military strategy, Hello History has a wide range of historical figures to choose from. You can have a chat with AI versions of many famous historical figures.

It's like having a private tutor with the greatest people of the past.

How it works:  The app uses state-of-the-art (GPT-4) AI technology to bring these figures to life and make the conversations feel authentic. Each conversation is completely unique. Don't trust everything the AI generates. The facts should be validated.

Enhance your knowledge of history and gain a new perspective on life by downloading Hello History today. Open up a conversation with anyone from the past, and who knows where it may take you!

P.S. New figures are added all the time, so you’ll never run out of interesting people to talk to.

The SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS

Hello History offers three auto-renewing subscription options:

1. Weekly

2. Month

3. Yearly

Subscription unlocks extra messages to historical figures.

You can send up to 10'000 messages per month if you are subscribed. Pricing per country may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and you will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term

- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

Read more about the privacy policy:

https://sites.google.com/view/hello-history-terms/privacy-policy

Read more about the terms of usage:

https://sites.google.com/view/hello-history-terms/home
